description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Wilhelt's triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zombie token, adding {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
